title.zh: 将 Luis Hora 纪念地区医院床位由一百（100）张增至两百（200）张、提升其服务设施与专业医疗护理并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Luis Hora Memorial Regional Hospital From One Hundred (100) to Two Hundred (200) Beds, Upgrading the Service Facilities and Professional Health Care Therein, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Luis Hora Memorial Regional Hospital From One Hundred (100) to Two Hundred (200) Beds, Upgrading the Service Facilities and Professional Health Care Therein, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11104_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The authorized bed capacity of the Luis Hora Memorial Regional Hospital in Bauko, Mountain Province is hereby increased from one hundred (100) to two hundred (200) beds which shall be implemented for a period of not more than three (3) years from the approval of this Act.

The existing hospital facilities and professional health care services of the Luis Hora Memorial Regional Hospital are also hereby upgraded and increased to conform with and be commensurate to the increase in bed capacity.

Upon prior consultation with the Luis Hora Memorial Regional Hospital, the Department of Health shall, in coordination with the Department of Budget and Management and the Civil Service Commission, determine the additional plantilla positions to be created and filled up in the workforce of the Luis Hora Memorial Regional Hospital.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
All laws, decrees, orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
